locations.name: Apollo Aggregates warehouse
locations.summary: About $10,000 in marked bills, two or three weapons, and a Leroy Rook collectible card.
locations.hint: East / south-east of Hamlet. Three large rectangular pools beside the highway, long red warehouse at the bend. Grey door beside the Apollo trailer.
tips: Pin is the Apollo Aggregates plant in Peregrine Bay, the site the basemap names; the guide describes it as east / south-east of Hamlet.

locations.name: Manatee Motel
locations.summary: Laird 350 sniper rifle and a cash safe on the top floor.
locations.hint: South-west of Hamlet on the eastern edge of the Gullet Marsh, north-east of Cottonmouth Lake. Top-floor room holds the weapon.

locations.name: Three Sheets Liquor — parrot stash
locations.summary: Cash hidden in an air vent behind the exotic-pet yard. The macaw marks the spot.
locations.hint: Key Lento, just north of the Pay 'n' Spray. Down the alley right of the storefront, through the broken chain-link. Vent beside the generator in the back corner.

locations.name: Steven Strachan Construction
locations.summary: Georgia collectible card (NINE1NINE Dancers set) on boxes in the back room.
locations.hint: Sunbelt Hwy in central Key Lento, across from Sunset Dr. Use the rear entrance; card sits on boxes next to a green container.

locations.name: Palmer Fishing Warehouse
locations.summary: Safe with ~$3,000, a Gold KZ-59, and the safe code on the ground-floor computer.
locations.hint: Bobcat Key, off Watson Bay — south end of the key. Safe is upstairs in the lounge corner; read the code off the computer downstairs first.
tips: Read the code off the ground-floor computer before going upstairs — the safe will not open otherwise.
Sources disagree between 1886 and 1887; try 1886 first, then 1887.
Arrive by boat; the key has no road in.
Pin is the cove at the south end of Bobcat Key, the end of the key the guide names.

locations.name: Permit Keys wrecks
locations.summary: Suppressed Assassin Nipper .38 and a Smuggler Gorse 425 shotgun on two separate islands.
locations.hint: Two islands. Suppressed pistol in deck hatch on the Derelict Spy Vessel wreck at the south-east Permit Keys tip. Shotgun on the sand beside a tilted boat on the northernmost island. Boat or jet ski required.
tips: Pin marks the Permit Keys themselves; the spy-vessel wreck is at the south-east tip and the tilted boat on the northernmost island.

locations.name: Wetman Bay fishing shacks
locations.summary: Kingfishers W-22 in a case on the kitchen counter of the main shack.
locations.hint: Middle island in Wetman Bay, west of Pelican Valley and north-west of Key Lento. The W-22 sits in a case on the kitchen counter of the salmon-red main house over the dock.
tips: Pin is Wetman Bay; the salmon-red main shack is on the middle island inside the bay.

locations.name: Pelican Valley research outpost
locations.summary: Safe (~$1,000–$1,100), $10,000 in marked bills in the boathouse, and a Crabshack VF5 SMG.
locations.hint: The outpost's marsh island in Pelican Valley, just south of the Gullet Marsh and well north of the Keys. Boat only. 0072 is the safe code; 0212 is the boathouse keypad. PC password reported as CLEAVES.
tips: Pin is the outpost itself — the building cluster the basemap draws at -3962, -4104. It used to sit in open water off Gambit Bay, 1.8 km south-east of here.
Two different codes: 0072 is the safe, 0212 is the boathouse keypad. Do not mix them up.
The PC password (CLEAVES) is reported separately from both codes.
Boat only — the outpost island has no road access.

locations.name: Abandoned site north of the airstrip
locations.summary: Alien bunker and UFO encounter content. Keypad code is dream-derived and may differ per save.
locations.hint: North-east of Cottonmouth Lake and south of Hamlet, at the north end of the long airstrip. Keypad code 2314 is commonly reported but can vary.
tips: 2314 is the commonly reported code but it may differ per save — if it fails, the code is dream-derived, not found in the world.
Anchor on the north end of the airstrip, then walk north-east toward the bunker.
No firm confirmation of what the bunker leads to; treat the outcome as unverified.

locations.name: Kingpin Bowling safe
locations.summary: Cash safe and a Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun via the Kolt & Associates robbery.
locations.hint: Southern Port Gellhorn on US-9, just south of the Pawn & Gun. Safe is in the back office. All three Port Gellhorn codes are written on the wall map at Brooks Boatworks.
rewards: Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun (via Kolt & Associates robbery)
tips: Most guides say 0300; one says 0330. Try 0300 first.
All three Port Gellhorn codes are written on the wall map at Brooks Boatworks — read them there instead of guessing.
The Gutterball shotgun is elsewhere in the building, not inside the safe.
Pin is the Pawn & Gun on US-9 in southern Port Gellhorn; the bowling alley and its back-office safe are just south of it.

locations.name: Brooks Boatworks
locations.summary: Clunker 556 carbine, an upstairs safe, and a wall map listing all three Port Gellhorn codes.
locations.hint: Northern Port Gellhorn waterfront near the bridge to Draper Island. Enter through the east fence hole, climb the grey building's outside stairs to the room with the wall map (codes: 6823, 6969, 0300).
tips: The outside stairs are the way in — the front is sealed.
Read the wall map while you are here: it lists 6823, 6969 and 0300 for the whole Port Gellhorn set.
Pin is the northern rail bridge towards Draper Island, the waterfront the guide names; the basemap has no Brooks Boatworks landmark.

locations.name: La Cascara Motel
locations.summary: Scrapper VF5C SMG, $15,000, and a safe (code 6969) in the gated top-floor room.
locations.hint: Western Port Gellhorn shoreline on Draper Bay, south of the rail bridge to Draper Island, near Wild Hog Point.
tips: The room is gated and guarded; clear the floor before opening the safe.
Approach from the Draper Bay shoreline, south of the rail bridge.
Pin is the La Cascara Motel itself, on the Draper Bay shoreline south of the rail bridge.

locations.name: The couch in the tree
locations.summary: Couch Potato Mustang .357 revolver. Shoot the ropes to drop the couch from the tree.
locations.hint: Tanglewood Ln in Port Gellhorn, outside a mobile home. A couch hangs from a tree — shoot the ropes to drop it, then search it.
tips: Pin marks the trailer park on Port Gellhorn's western edge; the basemap has no Tanglewood Lane landmark, so the couch hanging in the tree is the identifier.

locations.name: Meteorite at Hillside Campsite
locations.summary: Meteorite item in a shallow crater between the tents. Purple smoke marks the spot.
locations.hint: Eastern side of Mount Kalaga National Park, near Hillside Campsite south-west of Dawson Dam. Purple smoke marks the spot, roughly halfway up the trail.

locations.name: Dog Island — jet-ski dog
locations.summary: $1,218 wallet found after following Cool Dog's jet ski to Dog Island.
locations.hint: Ride Cool Dog's jet ski and stay on it — the dog leads you to the island south of Bobcat Key. An upturned boat marks the landing.

locations.name: Glider in the treeline
locations.summary: Turnt Nipper .38 pistol on a powered paratrike hung in the pines.
locations.hint: Bobcat Bight, northern tip of the Mariana coast. A powered paratrike is hung in a pine — shoot the lines to bring it down, then take the pistol off the seat.
tips: Pin is Bobcat Bight on the northern Mariana coast; the paratrike hangs in the pines above the bight.

locations.name: Janjak's Garage — office safe
locations.summary: San4San weed garage in La Perle. Office safe (code 4444) plus a pink Declasse Gin Tulip and the San4San KZ-59 rifle in the building.
locations.hint: La Perle, Vice City. The safe is in the office of the San4San garage. The code is written on a note stuck to the office fridge — read it before you open anything.
tips: The code is on the office fridge — you can read it without triggering the robbery.
The Gin Tulip and the KZ-59 are elsewhere in the garage, not in the safe.
Pin is a region-level estimate; the guide names La Perle, not coordinates.

locations.name: Black Eagle warehouse — door & safe
locations.summary: Six-digit door and safe codes, and a Kalinga .50 pistol in the safe.
locations.hint: The door keypad takes 789987 and the safe inside takes 031462. Two different six-digit codes — do not swap them.
tips: Both codes are six digits; the door one is the one that looks like a pattern.
Pin is a region-level estimate — the guide does not give a street address.

locations.name: Red Apple Orchard garage
locations.summary: Garage keypad hides the Applesauce Bobcat vehicle.
locations.hint: The garage door runs on keypad code 360782. Punch it in and drive the Bobcat out.
tips: Six digits — the only six-digit code at this location.
Pin is the Red Apple Orchard in Kelly County, north-west of Port Gellhorn; the garage is on the property.

locations.name: Cottonmouth Lake trailer
locations.summary: Free-roam safe on the sandbar island south of the lake.
locations.hint: Trailer on the sandbar island just south of Cottonmouth Lake. The code is a five-digit one shown on the postcards beside the bed.
tips: Five digits, which is unusual — do not pad it with a leading zero.
Read the postcards by the bed if the safe rejects the code.
Pin is Cottonmouth Lake; the trailer is on the sandbar island just south of it.

locations.name: Watson Bay safehouse
locations.summary: Security-compound safe tucked under the microwave.
locations.hint: Watson Bay, near Bobcat Key. The safe is under the microwave in the kitchen. The code is the last line of an email on the kitchen PC.
tips: The compound is guarded — clear it before you start reading the PC.
Turn the microwave over; the safe is underneath it, not behind it.
Pin sits on Bobcat Creek between Watson Bay and Bobcat Key, the 'near Bobcat Key' side the guide names; the basemap has no landmark for the safehouse compound.

locations.name: Nova Auto Junkyard safe
locations.summary: Junkyard safe outside Hamlet. Code is memorable, which is the hint.
locations.hint: Nova Auto Junkyard, Hamlet. Four repeated digits — the most memorable code in the game, easy to overlook because it looks too obvious.
tips: Four identical digits; if a code does not stick, look for the safe rather than the clue.
Pin is Hamlet town centre at the water tower; the guide names the town only and the basemap has no Nova Auto Junkyard landmark.

sources.label: Rock Paper Shotgun — all safe codes

locations.name: Delights Cabaret office safe
locations.summary: Office safe in the Port Gellhorn club. The code arrives by text, not by note.
locations.hint: Delights Cabaret, Port Gellhorn. You do not find this code in the world — Vicki texts it to you during the 'Afternoon Delight' mission. If you skipped the mission, the safe stays shut.
tips: Mission-gated: check your phone messages if the keypad ignores you.
The code is also the year the club was founded, per in-game signage.
Pin is Delights on Interstate 404, in central Port Gellhorn.

sources.label: Rock Paper Shotgun — all safe codes

locations.name: Dino Golf — Brontasaurus Bat
locations.summary: Batting-cage melee weapon at the abandoned mini-golf on SR-32.
locations.hint: Dino Golf at Frogswater, off SR-32. Walk into the batting cage on the right-hand side of the abandoned attraction; the bat is propped inside.
tips: There is no code and no fight — it is a walk-up pickup, easy to miss because the cage looks closed.
Pin is a region-level estimate; guides name Frogswater and SR-32 without coordinates.

locations.name: Kingfishers' Sunrise RV Park
locations.summary: Akulus 'Kingfishers' heavy revolver inside a trailer during the raid on the illegal operation.
locations.hint: The trailer in the RV park. It appears during the Chapter 3 raid on the Kingfishers' illegal operation — the game shows 'Valuables found' when you are next to it.
tips: Chapter 3 raid only; in free roam the trailer is empty.
Search the trailers in order — the revolver is in the one that triggers the 'Valuables found' prompt.
Pin is Sunrise RV Park, the park the guides place the Kingfishers' trailer operation in.

locations.name: Final Chapter compound — KVGA-12
locations.summary: KVGA-12 'Final Chapter' automatic shotgun in the Final Chapter gang's Ambrosia territory.
locations.hint: Ambrosia, in the Final Chapter's area. Go in heavy — the compound is defended, and the shotgun sits inside rather than on a rack outside.
tips: Treat it as an assault, not a pickup: bring armour and a rifle.
Ambrosia is a named region on the map, so use the region filter to frame the search.

locations.name: Gullet Marsh hut — Akulus & SM-69
locations.summary: Two unique weapons in one spot: an Akulus revolver inside the hut and an SM-69 sniper on the planks outside.
locations.hint: Wooden hut east of the abandoned crab lab in Gullet Marsh. The Akulus revolver is next to a body inside, with a phone playing a video. The SM-69 sniper is on the planks in front of the same hut, ammunition included.
tips: Two pickups, one building — check the planks outside before you leave.
Use the crab lab outpost as the anchor; this hut is immediately east of it.
The phone by the body plays a short video; it is part of the find, not a clue.

locations.name: The literal Easter egg nest
locations.summary: A bird's nest full of painted eggs at the top of the tallest TV tower, plus a parachute one level up.
locations.hint: Tallest TV tower in Vice-Dale County, south Vice City. Find the ladder at the foot of the tower and keep climbing — expect six to fifteen minutes. Take an egg from the nest and throw it off the ledge at full power for a cutscene.
rewards: Free parachute one level above the nest
Backyard Wrestling card on the way up (reported)
tips: Budget real time for the climb — guides clock it at six to fifteen minutes of ladders.
Throw the egg at full power off the edge, or nothing happens.
There is a base jump from the platform above, and a free parachute to go with it.
Pin is a region-level estimate; guides place the tower in Vice-Dale County without coordinates.

locations.name: UFO abduction on the back road
locations.summary: Player-reported night abduction east of Port Gellhorn, near the Starlet Motel. No published trigger.
locations.hint: Back road east of Port Gellhorn, near the Starlet Motel. Reported after Chapter 2, around 2 a.m. in-game time: follow the trail from the abandoned car into the woods.
tips: Player reports only — nobody has published a reliable trigger, so treat it as a rumour.
If you go looking, set the in-game clock to about 02:00 and drive the back road slowly.
Pin is the Starlet Motel on the back road east of Port Gellhorn; the encounter itself is unconfirmed.

locations.name: Search for the Skunk Ape
locations.summary: Hidden side mission: find Kirk's flyers, follow his drone through the swamp at night, then hunt the effigies.
locations.hint: Look for Kirk's flyers around Leonida — they add him to your contacts. Meet him at Pelican River at night, follow his drone into the swamp (Gullet Marsh / south of Cottonmouth Lake), then search Pelican Valley for the dolls carved into trees.
rewards: Skunk Ape side story with a choice at the end
tips: Night only — the meeting will not start in daylight.
Use Focus Mode in the mangroves; you lose the creature on purpose the first time.
The dolls carved into trees come after the chase, not during it.
Guides disagree on the exact marsh, so the pin is an area, not a spot.

locations.name: The crab lab — Karkinos
locations.summary: Abandoned research outpost in the Gullet Marsh where someone experimented on crabs. A diary names Karkinos.
locations.hint: The research outpost on its marsh island, where the Gullet Marsh runs into Pelican Valley. Read the diary on the PC — it tells of a giant crab called Karkinos — then work the safe and the boathouse. This is the same outpost as the Pelican Valley stash entry; that pin covers the loot, this one covers the story.
rewards: Free-roam access to the outpost safe and boathouse
tips: Pin is the outpost buildings themselves at -3962, -4104, not the Gambit Bay water this record used to point at.
Read the PC diary before you touch the safe — the password and both codes come from the same trail.
Boat only; there is no road onto the island.
Chapter 3 is when most players reach it, though the island is reachable earlier.

locations.name: Pegassi Infernus '96 — police garage
locations.summary: Retro supercar on level 7 of the Crosstown Police Station car park.
locations.hint: Crosstown Police Station on NW 9th St, Vice City. The Infernus sits on level 7. Drive in behind a patrol car so the gate opens, then either leave by the top-floor stunt jump or drive back down past the desk.
tips: You need the Key Cloner to keep it.
Wait outside the gate for a patrol car to leave, then follow it in — the door will not open otherwise.
The top-floor stunt jump is the cleaner exit; driving down past the desk is the risky one.
Two separate guides place it on level 7. The pin is a region-level estimate.

locations.name: Pegassi Vitello — Waning Sands villa
locations.summary: Hypercar in the garage of a villa on Flamingo Pkwy, Waning Sands.
locations.hint: Waning Sands, Leonard County. Go over the fence, then take the garage beside the house — on your right as you face the entrance.
tips: Key Cloner needed to keep it.
One guide plants charges on the gate coming in and blows them on the way out; the fence is quieter.
It is very fast and easy to wreck on the way home.

locations.name: Pegassi Tempesta — tow-truck argument
locations.summary: Random street event on NE 3rd St: the owner is arguing with a repo man and the car is on the tow truck.
locations.hint: NE 3rd St, Vice City, around 1 p.m. in-game time. Scare the owner off, drop the car off the tow truck and drive.
tips: Timed event — if the street is quiet, come back around 13:00.
The car is on the truck, so you need to free it before you can drive it.
Three guides describe the same event, which makes this one of the more reliable car spawns.

locations.name: Bravado Banshee — Sweetbay Inn
locations.summary: Sports car parked outside the Sweetbay Inn on East Buckley Dr, Capri.
locations.hint: Capri, East Buckley Drive, in front of the Sweetbay Inn. Shows up between 3 and 4 a.m.
tips: 3–4 a.m. only — sleep or wait out the clock.
Key Cloner needed to keep it.
Capri is a Gulf-coast town in Mariana County, south of Port Gellhorn where I-404 meets US-183 — not a Vice City suburb.
Pin marks central Capri: no published landmark for the Sweetbay Inn or East Buckley Drive, so the 3–4 a.m. spawn and the inn frontage are the identifier.

locations.name: Pegassi Toros — Pegassi Residences
locations.summary: SUV parked at the Pegassi Residences entrance on Bayside Dr.
locations.hint: Tequesta Retreat, Bayside Drive, Vice City. Turn up around 6:30 p.m.; security is nearby.
tips: Security patrols the entrance — grab it and go rather than lingering.
Key Cloner needed to keep it.
Pin is the Pegassi Residences north tower at Tequesta Retreat, the address the guide gives.

locations.name: Starfish Island mansion garage — three cars
locations.summary: Three luxury cars in one garage, plus a fourth on the driveway.
locations.hint: Starfish Island, Vice Beach — the mansion at the end of the long central road. The garage holds a Pegassi Vitello, a Grotti Itali RSX and a Benefactor Dubsta. The Piccia Big Cat Furia sits outside on the driveway ring.
tips: Four vehicles in one visit — bring somewhere to store them or accept losing three.
Check the driveway before you leave; the Furia has its own spot outside.
Key Cloner (Chapter 3) needed to keep any of them.
Pin is the Vercetti Estate, the mansion at the end of Starfish Island's central road.

locations.name: Vespucci Island film-tribute tuner
locations.summary: Bright green tuner in a locked Vespucci Island garage — a Fast & Furious Eclipse nod. Keepable from the start.
locations.hint: One of the Rialto Islands, west of Vice Beach, on Vespucci Island. It is in a house garage; go in through the small side door and press the wall control to open the main garage door.
tips: No Key Cloner needed — this one is free from the start.
Side door first; the main door is controlled from a wall panel inside.
Sources disagree on the model name (one calls it a Maibatsu Penumbra FF, others an Eclipse tribute) — the location is what they agree on.

locations.name: Royal Ruby Emerus — Vespucci Mansion
locations.summary: Red Progen Emerus hypercar in the small garage of Vespucci Mansion, guarded.
locations.hint: Vespucci Island. The small garage of the mansion. Armed guards patrol the estate — fight through or sneak in.
tips: Armed guards; do not stroll up the drive.
It is in the small garage, not the main one.
Key Cloner needed to keep it.

locations.name: Custom Bravado Gauntlet — Reservoir St
locations.summary: Blue-and-orange Gauntlet in a riverside house on Reservoir Street, north-east Ambrosia.
locations.hint: North-east Ambrosia. Look for the American flag and the basketball hoop above the garage, then crouch beside the door to force it open.
rewards: Its livery unlocked at Vice Vinyl
tips: Force the door from crouch — there is no keypad and no open door.
Taking it also unlocks the livery at Vice Vinyl, so it is worth doing even if you sell the car.
The flag and hoop are the landmark; the house is easy to miss from the road.

locations.name: Devil's Rope Gauntlet — Hog Stars Garage
locations.summary: Gang-styled Gauntlet inside a biker compound on Acacia Street, Ambrosia.
locations.hint: Hog Stars Garage, Acacia Street, Ambrosia. Armed bikers and a guard dog inside. Skip the front: climb the ladder at the back and drop in through the roof hatch, then open the vehicle exit and drive out.
tips: Roof hatch is the whole plan — the front door is a firefight with a dog.
You need to open the vehicle exit from inside before you can drive out.
Bring a silenced weapon for the bikers if you go loud by accident.

locations.name: Gauntlet Hellfire — M7 junkyard
locations.summary: Muscle car at the M7 junkyard east of Boone Speedway, off Galena St near Hamlet.
locations.hint: M7 junkyard east of Boone Speedway, off Galena Street, Hamlet. Available at any time.
tips: Single-source entry — treat the exact yard as approximate until you see it.
Anchor on Boone Speedway and head east along Galena St.
Pin sits just east of Boone Speedway, as far as the guide's 'east of the speedway' line can be placed; the basemap has no M7 landmark.

locations.name: Annis Drifter Elegy — Qwick-Fix workshop
locations.summary: Hidden drift car in the Qwick-Fix workshop behind the drag strip at Gellhorn International Raceway.
locations.hint: Port Gellhorn, Gellhorn International Raceway. The workshop sits behind the drag strip — go around the back of the strip rather than through the grandstand.
tips: Single-source entry; the pin points at the raceway, not the workshop door.
It is a drift car, so expect it to handle loose on the way out.

locations.name: Trinity Apartments — the Dexter nod
locations.summary: Building modelled on Dexter Morgan's Miami apartment, on Washington Island between the Pay 'n' Spray and the Vice Beach Top Fun Drones icon.
locations.hint: Washington Island, Vice City — between the Pay 'n' Spray and the Vice Beach Top Fun Drones marker. Look at the building and the dock behind it; rooftop tools and a boat are also reported nearby.
tips: Whether the unit can be entered is disputed — at least one guide says no.
Check the dock as well as the building; the boat is part of the nod.

locations.name: Belville house garage
locations.summary: Break-in house in Belville, Leonard County, with a garage worth opening.
locations.hint: Belville, Leonard County. Break into the garage — the source does not spell out what is inside, only that players keep reporting it.
tips: Single-source and vague: nobody has published exactly what is in the garage.
Try it only if you are already in Leonard County; it is not worth a detour on its own.

locations.name: BURG underwater research labs (five)
locations.summary: Five abandoned BURG Industries research stations on the seabed, each under an unmarked yellow platform. Their laptops tell one story, and one lab's safe holds a meteorite.
locations.hint: Start in open water east of Key Lento: find the yellow platform, climb down its ladder, dive under the structure and swim up through the hatch in its underside. Read the laptop, then close it — the Locate Underwater Meteorite task starts and the messages give the safe code. The other four labs are listed in the tips.
rewards: Five of the 33 Underwater Discoveries that count toward 100%
tips: The five are spread around the coast, not in one place: east of Key Lento, west of Mile Zero Air Station (south of the Riquezas Keys — this is the one with the meteorite safe), off Little Hardin Island in Leonard County, off Wild Hog Point in Kelly County, and beside the Sandbars.
This pin marks the Key Lento station because it is the one to visit first: it grants the objective and the code.
Every lab is entered the same way — yellow platform on the surface, ladder down, dive underneath, swim up through the hatch in the floor.
Bring scuba gear plus a boat, or a Sea Sparrow, which lands on water and saves a long trip between sites.
Guides disagree on the facility numbers (one calls the meteorite lab Facility 1, another numbers it fourth), so navigate by the landmark rather than the number.
A second meteorite lies on the seabed outside the meteorite lab and would not respond to interaction for the guide that tried it; the interior safe is the one that works.
The mystery is unfinished: the objective can stay active after the pickup, and one guide was able to take the meteorite twice.

locations.name: Caliente Picador & Royal Sanchez — container field
locations.summary: Two free vehicles in shipping containers in a field just above Grass Rivers: a yellow container holds the Caliente Picador, an orange one the Royal Sanchez motorcycle.
locations.hint: Container storage yard in the field a little above (north of) Grass Rivers, behind a broken building. Get into the broken building and push the stacked containers aside with a bulldozer until the yellow container has room to open.
tips: Bulldozer first — the stacked containers in front of the yellow one block its doors.

Most guides only mention the bulldozer at this yard, but the yellow SCOOP containers at the other two spots need the Cut-Off Tool (Chapter 3, Meet the Heders). Bring it in case this yard's containers are locked too.
Sources describe the containers as having no alarm.
To keep either one, garage it before you switch character, then register it at a Pay 'n' Spray.
North Mariana County is the same yard to both guides; the pin is a yard-level estimate, not a container number.

locations.name: Blue Drake Penumbra — raceway container
locations.summary: Blue Drake Penumbra with nitrous already fitted, in a yellow SCOOP container outside the raceway building, south Port Gellhorn.
locations.hint: South of Port Gellhorn by the race tracks — the yellow container next to the Port Gellhorn raceway building. Cut the padlock with the Cut-Off Tool.
tips: Cut-Off Tool required; you get it in the Chapter 3 mission Meet the Heders and keep it for good.
Nitrous is already installed, so it is quick off the line.
Container has no alarm.
The Drifter Elegy entry points at the workshop behind the drag strip; this container sits by the raceway building itself.
Pin is the raceway's covered grandstands, beside the raceway building the guide names; no coordinates are published for the container itself.

locations.name: Muck Spreader Bandito — Hamlet containers
locations.summary: Dune buggy in one of the yellow containers on the south side of Hamlet, near Boone Speedway.
locations.hint: South side of Hamlet. Open the yellow container beside the building with the Cut-Off Tool.
tips: Cut-Off Tool required (Chapter 3, Meet the Heders).
Sources spell it both Muck Spreader and Muxbreeder Bandito — same vehicle.
Container has no alarm.
Pin is Boone Speedway itself; the containers are on the south side of Hamlet beside it.

locations.name: Pet Cemetery — Grayson
locations.summary: A clearing of tiny graves in the woods by SR-73 in southern Grayson — a Pet Sematary nod that scans as WAiNK Curiosity 19 of 35.
locations.hint: Grayson, south-west Lummox County on SR-45. Park at Hucks Pump n Go and read the missing-pet posters on the walls, then walk round the back past the green dumpsters to the breeze-block wall with 'Ghost Trail', 'Sightings in forest' and 'Turn back' signs nailed to it. The dirt path runs up the hill on the left of the wall — follow it into the trees to the clearing.
rewards: Lore: the names on the graves match the missing-pet posters in town
tips: Second route: come down SR-73 into southern Grayson and use Focus to follow the strange animal noises to the graves.
Read the posters before you climb. Dempster, Scramps, Mr. Jiggles, Brendon, Geep and Bonzo are the joke, and their names are on the stones.

A player report says following a cat through the fog unlocks a zombie deer tattoo; the outlet that filmed the cemetery walked up in daylight, saw no cat, and got no tattoo. Treat the tattoo as unconfirmed.
Pin is Grayson town, where the Ghost Trail starts behind the shops; the cemetery itself has no basemap landmark, so the walk from the posters is the identifier.

sources.label: Middle East Gamer — pet cemetery walkthrough

locations.name: Declasse Ghosts Exposed Parkland — Halloween house
locations.summary: Black-and-turquoise '71 station wagon covered in ghosts and pumpkins, parked in the driveway of a Halloween house in Capri — the Ghostbusters nod, with Let's Haunt across the back.
locations.hint: Capri, Mariana County: Fortuna Street at Viola Street, just south of Tortoise Lake. Look for the house with a giant skeleton sprawled across the roof, pumpkins filling the yard and yellow tape on the lawn; the wagon is in the driveway in front of the garage door.
rewards: 'Spooked Out' livery unlocked at Vice Vinyl
Book Swap stand at the same house
tips: No lock, no alarm, no tracker and no window to break — walk up and get in.
Sitting in the driver's seat unlocks the 'Spooked Out' livery at Vice Vinyl.
Registering it with Moses or at a Pay 'n' Spray strips the livery; take it back to Vice Vinyl afterwards to reapply it.
Four trunk storage slots, so it doubles as a hauler.
Grab the Book Swap at the house while you are there.
Pin is anchored on Tortoise Lake, the named landmark: guides give the Fortuna/Viola corner and no coordinates, so the dot marks the ground just south of the lake.

locations.name: Annis Pixel Elegy — Capri Construction Yard
locations.summary: Custom '90 Annis Elegy street racer with a unique design, locked in a yellow SCOOP container at the back of the Capri construction yard by the pier.
locations.hint: Capri construction yard, by the pier. The container is at the back of the site — shove the portable toilet and the crate out of the way with a vehicle, then cut the padlock with the Cut-Off Tool.
rewards: Annis Pixel Elegy (custom '90 street racer, Skyline GT-R-inspired)
tips: Cut-Off Tool required (Chapter 3, Meet the Heders).
The portaloo and the crate are what block the doors — push them with a car or truck, not on foot.
gtabase lists its security as modern and warns a Key Cloner may be needed; other guides treat it as a plain container. Bring the cloner if you have it.
Register it to keep it, but note that the respray registration forces will cost you the unique design.
No alarm and no mission gate reported — it is a free pickup once the container is open.
Pin is anchored on the Capri pier, which the yard sits beside; guides give the yard and no coordinates.
Capri is on the Gulf coast in Mariana County, south of Port Gellhorn — the yard is at the town's seaward edge, not in Vice City.

locations.name: Reynolds Kit Car wreck 3 — Wild Hog Point beach
locations.summary: Third of the five Reynolds Kit Car wrecks for Wyman's Classic Cars: an orange container on its own on the west beach of Wild Hog Point, southwest of Port Gellhorn. You scan it, you do not drive it.
locations.hint: West of Port Gellhorn on Wild Hog Point. Drive to the end of the airstrip, turn right onto the sand road, and when the beach is directly west of you leave the road towards the water — you will find a scatter of discarded containers. The lone orange one is the car: cut it open with the Cut-Off Tool and scan the wreck inside with WAiNK.
rewards: Reynolds Kit Car wreck 3 of 5 (WAiNK scan)
Progress toward Wyman's Reynolds Kit Car
tips: This is a scan, not a free car. Wyman builds the Reynolds Kit Car only after all five wrecks and a $1,500 mechanics fee paid through BuckMe.
Ultimate Edition only — Wyman's Classic Cars is the Ultimate Edition side quest that opens in Chapter 2.
Cut-Off Tool required (Chapter 3, Meet the Heders); guides also call it the angle grinder.
Track progress under Exploration > Find Cars for Wyman.
Register the finished car at a Pay 'n' Spray for $100, or park it in a garage you own, or it stays at his scrapyard.
Pin is the Wild Hog Point beach landmark; the airstrip runs about 230 m east of it.

locations.name: Exploding beached whale
locations.summary: A whale stranded on the Gulf shore bursts when you walk up to it, flinging cocaine bricks, a pistol and a wheelchair across the sand.
locations.hint: North-west coast between Capri and Port Gellhorn: follow the shoreline until you find the whale on the beach, then approach it on foot.
tips: The bang is the event — expect to take a little damage if you stand right next to it.
The bricks scatter a long way; bring a vehicle with space and sweep the beach afterwards.

locations.name: Fountain of Youth
locations.summary: A gazebo fountain in Capri that refills health, stamina and the third bar to their temporary maximum.
locations.hint: Capri, Mariana County: the fountain under the gazebo on the town's main green. Drink from it.
rewards: Full health, stamina and third bar (temporary ceiling)
tips: The boost raises the ceiling for the current run; it is not a permanent upgrade.

locations.name: Bugstar van and fumigation tent
locations.summary: A Bugstar pest-control van from Los Santos parked beside a fumigation tent in Capri — the GTA V exterminator front, transplanted to Leonida.
locations.hint: Capri: look for the tented building and the van carrying the Bugstar livery.
tips: Scenery, not a drivable reward — the joke is the livery.

sources.label: GTABase map — Easter Egg: Bugstar Van

locations.name: Possessed-Lucia factory
locations.summary: A disused factory on Capri's northern edge with a paranormal set piece inside.
locations.hint: North Capri, Mariana County: the abandoned factory building; the scene triggers inside, not at the door.
tips: A scripted scene rather than a pickup; there is nothing to carry out.

sources.label: GTABase map — Easter Egg: Lucia Possessed

locations.name: Disco toilet
locations.summary: A portable toilet rigged with a disco ball and a bar: somebody threw a party in it, and the drinks are still there.
locations.hint: South of Capri on the coast road towards Bobcat Key: the lone portable toilet standing off the roadside.
tips: A one-joke location; the drinks are the only thing in it.

locations.name: Leviathan graffiti
locations.summary: Graffiti on the southern islands insisting the Leviathan is real and lives in Leonida.
locations.hint: Southern Leonida Keys: the painted wall near the water, on the island marked for the rumour.
tips: Part of the Leviathan rumour thread rather than a collectible; nothing to pick up.

locations.name: Satan at the biker campfire
locations.summary: At midnight a biker camp outside Port Gellhorn starts a ritual: a van arrives, a portal opens and you end up fighting Satan.
locations.hint: Port Gellhorn, Kelly County: the biker camp on the northern side of town. Be there at midnight and drink with them.
tips: Time-gated: midnight only, so wait the clock out rather than driving in during the day.
It is a real fight, not a cutscene — arrive armed.

locations.name: Four Horses monument
locations.summary: A globe held up by four horses. Look through the lens during a lightning storm and the globe can be entered.
locations.hint: Kelly County, north-west of Port Gellhorn: the four horses statue with the globe. Use the lens in a thunderstorm, then fly a plane or helicopter into the globe.
tips: Weather-gated: wait for a lightning storm before the lens does anything.
You need an aircraft to get inside once it opens.

locations.name: Satanic room — Benson Real Estate
locations.summary: A candle-lit satanic shrine in the back of the Benson real estate office in Grayson.
locations.hint: Grayson, Lummox County: inside the Benson Real Estate office in town.
tips: Pair it with the burning house and the ghost cat a few streets away — Grayson has the densest cluster of these.

sources.label: GTABase map — Satanic Room (Benson Real Estate office)

locations.name: Burning house
locations.summary: A Grayson house that catches fire at random and is rebuilt step by step over later visits.
locations.hint: Grayson, Lummox County: the house on the edge of town. If it is not alight, come back another day.
tips: The fire is random and the rebuild is gradual, so this one only shows itself across several in-game days.

locations.name: Ghost cat
locations.summary: A cat that walks up beside the Grayson church, then vanishes.
locations.hint: Grayson, Lummox County: walk along the side of the church and wait for the cat to approach.
tips: A jump-scare, nothing to collect. The pet cemetery on the same hill is the bigger Ghost Trail secret.

locations.name: Super Mario question block
locations.summary: A floating question block in the Mount Kalaga backwoods that breaks open to unlock Mario and Luigi hats.
locations.hint: Northern Lummox County, in the Mount Kalaga woods: the block hangs over a clearing. Break it open.
tips: A wardrobe unlock rather than an item — check your outfits after breaking it.

locations.name: Mineshaft carcasses
locations.summary: A mine shaft piled with blood-soaked carcasses and fruit beside a broken ladder.
locations.hint: North Mount Kalaga, Lummox County: follow the mine adit until the shaft with the broken ladder.
tips: A scene, not a pickup; it sits close to the Moreau watchtower if you are doing the fire-tower mystery.

sources.label: GTABase map — Easter Egg: Mineshaft Carcasses

locations.name: Moreau fire watchtower
locations.summary: One of the fire watchtowers whose radio plays unsettling audio after dark.
locations.hint: North Mount Kalaga, Lummox County: climb the watchtower and switch the radio on at night.
tips: The audio is the whole reward; it belongs to the fire-watchtower mystery, so visit the towers together.

sources.label: GTABase map — Easter Egg: Moreau Watchtower

locations.name: Hyde Island kidnap
locations.summary: Setting foot on Hyde Island triggers a cutscene: a dart puts you down and you wake up as the hunted.
locations.hint: Hyde Island, off the far north coast of Lummox County. Approach by boat — the event fires the moment you land.
tips: One-shot scripted hunt; go in at full health, because you start it wounded.

sources.label: GTABase map — Hyde Island Kidnap Challenge

locations.name: Cloned bodies bunker
locations.summary: A hillside bunker holding copies of Jason and Lucia, tied to The Final Flush.
locations.hint: North-east Lummox County: the sealed bunker in the hills above the north coast road.
tips: The scene depends on which protagonist you visit as.
The neighbouring bunker has a keypad door and its own code entry.

locations.name: Hillside bunker — door code 3612
locations.summary: A keypad bunker door in the far north hills; the code is 3612.
locations.hint: Far north Lummox County: the bunker door set into the hillside, east of the cloned-bodies bunker.
tips: Six digits? No — 3612 is four. Type it slowly, the pad resets on a wrong entry.

locations.name: Scarface chainsaw scene
locations.summary: The Scarface chainsaw scene staged as a set piece: three men run off with a car and the hotel room is left with the chair in it.
locations.hint: Vice Beach, southern Vice City: the hotel block where the three men flee with the car.
tips: A film reference, not a mission — watch it from the street.

locations.name: Haunted Marbelle Hotel
locations.summary: Mannequins in the corridors, doors that open themselves and the lights cutting out — plus a basement safe whose code is written on the roof.
locations.hint: Vice City: the Marbelle Hotel. Read the paper on the roof for the safe code, then open the basement safe.
tips: The code comes from a paper on the roof; 955214 is the one players report, so re-read the paper if it fails.

sources.label: GTABase map — Easter Egg: Haunted Marbelle Hotel

locations.name: Piano playing old GTA themes
locations.summary: A piano in a Rialto Islands garage that plays the Vice City (2002) theme, then GTA IV's, on a loop.
locations.hint: Rialto Islands, Vice City: break into the house garage — the piano is inside. Play it.
tips: The tunes cycle: Vice City, then GTA IV, then back to the start.

sources.label: GTABase map — Piano Playing Previous GTA Themes

locations.name: Dolores the snake
locations.summary: Dolores, a snake sitting on her eggs under a staircase in Key Lento, after Chapter 1.
locations.hint: Key Lento, Leonida Keys: under the exterior stairs of the building the map marks. She is not there before Chapter 1.
tips: Chapter 1 has to be done first — she simply is not there before that.

locations.name: Michael De Santa's boat
locations.summary: The boat Michael loses in GTA V's Father/Son mission, washed up in the Keys.
locations.hint: Key Lento, Leonida Keys: the stranded boat by the water, a few metres from Dolores the snake.
tips: Scenery only — the game will not let you keep it.

sources.label: GTABase map — Michael De Santa's Boat

locations.name: Grove Street cul-de-sac
locations.summary: A suburban cul-de-sac in Hamlet laid out as a Grove Street nod to San Andreas.
locations.hint: Hamlet, Mariana County: the cul-de-sac on the edge of town, built to the San Andreas street plan.
tips: A photo spot; there is nothing to collect.

sources.label: GTABase map — Grove Street (San Andreas reference)
